Why sums of random variables?
Sometimes modeling and understanding a complex RV, 𝑋, is difficult.
But if we can decompose 𝑋 into the sum of simpler, independent RVs,
• We can compute distributions on 𝑋.
• We can better understand how 𝑋 changes as its constituent RVs change.
